inventory_summary:
SCOPE: air side of the ERV: EQ-B-ERV (Broan B210E75RT), EQ-B-ERV-MAN-SUP/EXH, EQ-M/A plenums, EQ-S-ERV-MIX box, DU-B-ERV-SUP/RET-TRUNK, DU-ERV-RISER-SUP/EXH, DU-ERV-OA/EA (+wraps), DU-M-ERV-EXH-FEED/-TRUNK, DU-S-ERV-HP-FEED, two hoods, System 1 rectangular trunks DU-S-HP-SUP/-RET/-SUITE/-SOUTH/-SOUTH-RISE, 5 plenums + 1 mixing box (about 45 elements). Branch radials/fittings are M4's.

CHECKLIST TABLE (Y specified / N missing / P partial). Cols: mat+gauge | wrap R+jacket | sealing UL181 | named fitting each vertex | ends on real collar/transition | hangers | dampers | framing penetration | M-10x labels | BOM
- DU-B-ERV-SUP-TRUNK 6": P(galvanized, no gauge) | N (bare by design) | P(note only) | N (fitting_pattern UNKNOWN; elbow type unnamed) | P (start exact on port 2; end 7.7" off declared plenum station; 10.4" rise cannot hold Broan 12" flex) | N | P (Broan internal motorized damper only) | n/a boxed under TJI soffit | Y 6" RD SUPPLY | elbows only
- DU-B-ERV-RET-TRUNK 6": P | N | P | N | N (start 16.8" from port 1, on port 3) | N | P | n/a | Y | elbows only
- DU-ERV-OA 8": P | Y R-8.4 2x1" AP Armaflex, own vapour retarder, no outer jacket (note s.9; NOT on the set; BOM duct_insulation LF only) | P | N (24" take-offs UNKNOWN) | N (4.8" off port 4; no 6x8 transition/flex named) | N | N (undampered intake, Broan motorized) | Y 9x9 RO + seal kit | P (only on M-102, missing M-101/A-402) | elbows + wall-seal
- DU-ERV-EA 8": P | Y as OA | P | N (2.9" stub vs 12" take-off) | N (on port-1 location, 15.2" off port 3; wrap 1" into case) | N | N (BD8 specified; contradicts Broan) | Y | P | elbows + wall-seal; BD8 inside hood price
- DU-ERV-RISER-SUP/-EXH 6": P | N bare | P | N (5 and 4 straights below take-off) | Y (EXH ends on plenum riser port 1.1" ok) | N | N | fireblock Y; FO-* openings Y | Y | elbows
- DU-M-ERV-EXH-TRUNK 8": P | N | P | UNKNOWN | Y start on collar-trunk exact | N | N | Y 13" truss opening (0.25" margin) | Y 8" RD EXHAUST | elbows
- DU-M-ERV-EXH-FEED, DU-S-ERV-HP-FEED 6": P | N | P | N (7.7" vs 9", 3.4" vs 18") | Y/Y | N | N | Y | Y | elbows
- EQ-B-ERV-MAN-SUP/EXH (36x8x8 fabricated): P(no gauge/submittal) | N | P (mastic stated) | n/a | P (collars EXACT, 6" ports not graded; SUP trunk station stale) | N | N (collar butterfly dampers unnamed) | n/a | N (prints 'DUCT_MANIFOLD') | no collar/damper lines
- EQ-M-ERV-MAN-SUP: no feed (M1-111); EQ-M-ERV-MAN-EXH/EQ-A-ERV-MAN-EXH: same spec gaps as basement plenums
- EQ-S-ERV-MIX: gravity backdraft damper unnamed (no Product), 26 ga stated in type note only
- Hoods: RenewAire FA8-P basis (plate unpublished; not anti-gust; BD8 on discharge conflicts with Broan)
- System 1 rect trunks: gauge Y (26 ga 18"/10"-sides 30 ga, takeoff only, not on set); mastic/canvas connector stated in note s.11; hangers N (note s.13 'not graded'); balancing N

SYSTEMIC GAPS (each is a finding): ports cross-wired (M1-101), BD8 vs Broan (M1-102), required flex/transition connection (M1-103), elbow type vs static margin (M1-104), no supports (M1-105), no balancing-damper product (M1-106), BOM lacks fittings (M1-107), sheets carry no duct spec (M1-108/109), plenum station stale (M1-110), M-SUP unfed (M1-111).

HOLDS CARRIED: TODO OA/EA/RET hold: measured collar top to joist soffit ~22"; with Broan's 12" flex (bendable R>=3") the first leg can fit but the drawn stubs (EA 2.9", OA 8.9") do not, and the ports are cross-wired. TODO L86 (M-SUP feed): still unfed (M1-111). erv_static_budget 0.441" vs 0.4": the 0.441 is the genuine operating point (203.9 cfm interpolated 0.4"=206..0.5"=201 matches the spec fan table) and clears the 203.0 cfm code rate by 0.9 cfm; margin vanishes at +12 % elbow loss and 4 flex + 2 transitions are uncounted (M1-104).

WEB CHECKS: Broan B210E75RT spec sheet (ports p.2, SRE p.1, curve p.3), Broan AI-series installation manual 52 pp (hood damper, 12" flex, transitions, 3"/13" clearances, anti-gust, drainage), RenewAire FA8-P (no plate dims), RenewAire BD8 (P/N 102401 'mechanical butterfly, male/female ends'; no freeze guidance), Fantech FML8 store page 404, MN Rules 1322/1346/1309 (search snippets only).

NOT examined: SMACNA hanger table (paywalled; IMC 603.10 only defers); ASHRAE/SMACNA published loss coefficient for stamped adjustable elbows; current text of MN Rule 1346 (snippets only); Fantech FML8 current page; Broan 8"-collar/flex part numbers; TJI web-hole charts for System 1 joist-bay branches (M4); fabricator submittal for plenums (none exists); full-resolution zoom of M-102/M-103 label overprints beyond the page images.

findings.title: DU-ERV-EA starts on Broan port 1 (exhaust FROM building) and DU-B-ERV-RET-TRUNK starts on port 3 (exhaust TO outside): the two exhaust ports are cross-connected

evidence.measured: Case centre (80.4375, 358)" with rotation 0 (box W, door S). Authored port stations (Broan p.2) land at: port 1 return (75.28, 362.88), port 2 supply (88.66, 364.63), port 4 outdoor (77.03, 354.75), port 3 exhaust (86.78, 354.75). Run starts: SUP-TRUNK (88.66, 364.62) = 0.0" off port 2 (exact, closed). OA end (74.0, 351.0) = 4.8" off port 4 (nearest; ok-ish). DU-ERV-EA start (74.0, 363.0) is 1.3" from PORT 1 and 15.2" from its own port 3. DU-B-ERV-RET-TRUNK start (86.0, 350.0) is 4.8" from PORT 3 and 16.8" from its own port 1. mep.equipment_port_service passes both only at 'service level' because those port stations are certainty=APPROXIMATE (checks.json: 'no exact connection is established'), so nothing grades the swap.
evidence.expected: EA (exhaust to outside, port 3, SE collar) and RET trunk (exhaust from building, port 1, NW collar) each start within ~1/2" of THEIR OWN collar; the NW and SE collars carry the opposite streams to what is drawn.
evidence.method: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-colincatlin-Documents-NoCloud-TypeHaus/fc951bd3-20bf-434f-9b45-0a1dac7cd982/scratchpad/geometry-review/M1/p8.py (port world = case centre + authored offset; distance to ducts[tag].path[0]/[-1]); .venv python; compare with Broan spec sheet p.2 labels 1 'Exhaust air from building', 3 'Exhaust air to outside'. CLAUDE.md records OA/EA/RET as held at service level by the owner: this finding says the held layout is not merely loose, it is cross-wired, so whoever releases the hold must not keep these starts.

findings.source: https://broan-nutone.com/getmedia/9863cd5f-e206-478f-a30f-14d30c857c17/Spec_Sheet_B210E75RT_En_2.pdf p.2 (6" Ports Dimensions: 1 exhaust air from building, 2 fresh air to building, 3 exhaust air to outside, 4 fresh air from outside); houses/catlin/plan/mep_erv_types.py:79-100
findings.proposed_fix: Re-start DU-ERV-EA on port 3 (86.78, 354.75) and DU-B-ERV-RET-TRUNK on port 1 (75.28, 362.88), or swap the two ports' tags; then mark all four ports certainty=EXACT so mep.equipment_port_service grades them. Routing re-proposal is a route-run job.

findings.title: Discharge hood specifies an inline BD8 backdraft damper; Broan's manual says never put a non-return damper on the exhaust hood (it freezes), and the B210E75RT already has motorized port dampers

evidence.measured: EQ-T-ERV-HOOD-8-EXH name/source: 'inline BD8 backdraft damper'; PROD-AIR-BACKDRAFT-8 'On DU-ERV-EA only, inside the wall line'; takeoff.json cost row EQ-T-ERV-HOOD-8-EXH $240-530 vs intake $200-460. Broan AI-series manual (covers B210E75RT, header p.1) s.2.4 p.9: '* Do not install exhaust hood with non-return damper since it can freeze in winter'; repeated at fault codes E32 and W32 ('Make sure no non-return damper is installed in exhaust hood'). Spec sheet p.1 'Motorized dampers (no additional backdraft dampers required)'. 22.7 Pa discharge-hood loss in the static budget includes the BD8.
evidence.expected: Discharge hood without a non-return damper (the unit's own motorized exhaust damper closes the port); budget re-read without the BD8 term.
evidence.method: pdftotext of the downloaded manual (/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-colincatlin-Documents-NoCloud-TypeHaus/fc951bd3-20bf-434f-9b45-0a1dac7cd982/scratchpad/geometry-review/M1/dl_manual/ai.txt) grep 'non-return'; air_terminal_types.py:245-253; takeoff.json cost_estimate rows for the two hood types.

findings.title: Broan's required port connection (6->8 transition, 12" flex between port and rigid duct, tape only) is neither specified nor possible in the stubs above the collars

evidence.measured: Straight rise from collar top (z -33.84") to first bend: EA 2.9" (z -30.94), OA 8.9" (to -24.94), SUP trunk 10.4" (to plenum underside -23.44), RET trunk 2.5" then 9.0" (checks.json mep.fitting_pattern: 'DU-ERV-EA 2.9" between vertex 0 and 1 against 12.0"'; 'DU-B-ERV-RET-TRUNK 2.5" ... against 9.0"'). Headroom collar top to joist underside (~-11.88") ~22". Broan s.2.5 p.10: 'If using 8-in. ducts, install 6-in. to 8-in. transitions on the ports, secure using duct tape only. If rigid ducting is used, install a 12-in. section of flexible duct between the transition and the rigid ducting'; 'To avoid transmission of vibrations, always use a 12-inch section of flexible duct to connect rigid ducts to the unit'; 'Do not use screws ... to the ports'. No transition, flex connector, or 'no screws' note exists in the plan, set, or takeoff.json duct_fittings (only elbows and wall-seal kits).
evidence.expected: Each of the four ports shows port collar -> (6x8 transition on OA/EA) -> 12" flex (insulated, vapour-barrier tucked, on OA/EA) -> rigid duct, with a named part and a stub long enough to hold them (a 12" flex can itself bend, R>=3", which fits the 22" headroom, but the drawn 2.9" EA stub cannot).
evidence.method: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-colincatlin-Documents-NoCloud-TypeHaus/fc951bd3-20bf-434f-9b45-0a1dac7cd982/scratchpad/geometry-review/M1/p3.py (z of each leg), checks.json mep.fitting_pattern; manual text lines ~517-546 of /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-colincatlin-Documents-NoCloud-TypeHaus/fc951bd3-20bf-434f-9b45-0a1dac7cd982/scratchpad/geometry-review/M1/dl_manual/ai.txt.

findings.source: https://www.broan-nutone.com/getmedia/26847653-1424-49e1-9415-6b2e8becf223/Installation_Guide_AI_2_Broan_En_1.pdf p.10 (2.5 Connecting the Ducts to the Unit); p.11 (2.5.1: insulated ducts same diameter as the ports, R = 3" min)
findings.proposed_fix: Author the transition + 12" flex as named parts on each port (or a Product on the type's ports), lengthen the first leg, and bill them; this is part of the held OA/EA/RET re-route.

findings.title: The static budget's elbow loss is a smooth r/D=1.5 coefficient while the notes buy stamped adjustable elbows; the 0.9 cfm code margin disappears at +12 % elbow loss, and Broan's required flex/transition losses are not counted

evidence.measured: erv_static_budget: 0.441" w.g. worst path (extract via SAUNA-EXH), 203.9 cfm delivered vs 203.0 required (code.N1103_6 PASS by 0.9 cfm), vs the HVI-certified point 0.4"/206 cfm. Bend equivalent lengths are authored from C=0.22 'smooth r/D=1.5' (note §2) 'rounded up for a stamped adjustable elbow'; fittings.py names the catalog fitting 'gored elbow R=1.5D' while note §11/§3 say radials use 'stamped adjustable elbows' and mep.fitting_pattern is UNKNOWN on 17 runs ('No submittal gives the stocked stamped elbow's radius'). Sensitivity (round bend_equivalent_length x factor, engine check re-run): x1.0 -> 0.441"/203.9 PASS; x1.1 -> 0.455"/203.2 PASS; x1.2 -> 0.470"/202.5 UNKNOWN; x1.5 -> 0.513"/200.7 cfm code FAIL; x2.0 -> 0.585"/199.3 FAIL. G-005 prints 'DELIVERED 203.9 cfm'.
evidence.expected: Elbow type named (and its loss coefficient read from a published row), plus the manufacturer-required 12" flex and 6x8 transitions entered in the budget, with the margin still >= 0 after them.
evidence.method: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-colincatlin-Documents-NoCloud-TypeHaus/fc951bd3-20bf-434f-9b45-0a1dac7cd982/scratchpad/geometry-review/M1/p11.py <factor> (load_plan, model_copy each round DuctProductType.bend_equivalent_length*factor, checks.run; reports erv_static_budget and N1103).

findings.proposed_fix: Name the elbow (stamped adjustable vs gored) in the catalog, read its published coefficient, add the flex/transition terms; or take the owner's 10" hood margin option (note §10).

findings.title: No hanger, strap or support is specified for any ERV duct, plenum or riser (IMC 603.10 defers to SMACNA); note says hanger space is 'not graded'

evidence.measured: takeoff.json duct_fittings holds only elbows and wall-seal kits; no hanger/strap/support row exists for ducts (grep of takeoff.json and permit_set_full text: 0 duct hanger). Spans that need support: 17'-0" vertical 12"-OD wrapped EA riser; 28'-8" 8" EXH trunk crossing FS-S-WEST (11 7/8" open-web); 36" plenums hung from the basement joists 5.5" under the soffit; 6" riser horizontal legs. Note §13: 'Not graded: ... hanger space on the rectangular trunks'. Broan: unit hung on supplied chains (no more than 1/4" off level), duct supports not stated.
evidence.expected: Support type and interval per duct size/orientation from the SMACNA table IMC 2018 s.603.10 adopts (Minnesota Mechanical Code ch.1346), drawn or noted, billed per LF/each; wrapped legs supported outside the wrap.
evidence.method: grep takeoff.json keys 'duct_fittings', 'install_parts' for hanger/strap; pdftotext permit_set_full.pdf. Code row NOT retrieved: SMACNA HVAC Duct Construction Standards is paywalled; websearch confirms 2018 IMC s.603.10 contains no numeric table and points to SMACNA, so the interval must be taken from SMACNA, not memory.

findings.source: IMC 2018 s.603.10 (support per SMACNA; flexible per maker); houses/catlin/out/geometry-review-2026-11-04/baseline/takeoff.json
findings.proposed_fix: Add a duct-support note and a billed row (strap/hanger by diameter and orientation) to the HVAC sheets and takeoff.

findings.title: No named product for the balancing dampers: 23 plenum start collars are 'integral butterfly dampers' with no part, quadrant or lock; no damper at any trunk/riser; the BOM carries none

evidence.measured: Note §8 balances 'at the plenum, never at the grille ... Every port has a butterfly damper at the start collar'. Plenum types say 'N x 4in dampered collars' as a shop fabrication with 'No submittal has been read'; prices.toml: 'the start collars and their dampers are in these rows'. Only 6" spin-in (Master Flow LSCD6, 'locking quadrant not confirmed') and the plant 4" EWC 4RSD are named; Section §7 says 'specify the quadrant damper where the collar lacks one'. takeoff.json: no damper/collar quantity line. Sheets print 'DUCT_MANIFOLD' only.
evidence.expected: A named 4" balancing damper (quadrant, lockable) at each of 23 start collars, shown as a count/schedule, plus a damper spec note on the HVAC sheets.
evidence.method: grep plenum types in mep_erv_types.py; takeoff.json placeables/duct_fittings; pdftotext of sheets p162-165.

findings.proposed_fix: Name a 4" quadrant damper Product and a 'balance at collar' note/count; add to takeoff.

findings.title: takeoff.json carries no ductwork parts beyond elbows and wall seals: no 6x8 transitions, flex, take-offs/start collars, dampers, hangers, tape or mastic quantities

evidence.measured: takeoff.json duct_fittings = elbow-22.5/45/90 (by size) + 2 wall-seal-8in rows; no increaser/reducer, no flex, no start collar, no damper, no hanger. 'hvac-duct-insulation-mastic-and-test' is a $1.00-2.40/LF allowance on ducts.length_ft (consumables not counted); prices.toml notes 'the reducer is inside the duct $/LF'. duct_insulation bills OA/EA wrap as 48.9 LF of '2" elastomeric, two 1" layers, R-8.4' and PROD-AIR-ELASTOMERIC-1IN / PROD-AIR-WALL-SEAL-FOAM / PROD-AIR-BACKDRAFT-8 never appear as takeoff lines; the BD8 is inside the hood price.
evidence.expected: Parts a buyer orders appear as counted lines: transitions, flex, collars/take-offs, dampers, straps, UL 181 tape and mastic by LF/rolls, adhesive.
evidence.method: json scan of takeoff.json keys 'duct_fittings','duct_insulation','install_parts','cost_estimate' for the PROD-AIR-* tags (all absent except hood rows).

findings.proposed_fix: Add fitting rows to resolve/mep_fittings consumers (transition, flex) and Product-backed install_parts on runs.

findings.title: Hoods and plenums print as raw 'DUCT_MANIFOLD' with no tag; round-duct gauge is unstated (library says 26 ga, note says IRC asks 30 ga) and the notes cite IRC M1601 where Minnesota routes duct construction/sealing to Rule 1346

evidence.expected: Hood and plenum labelled by function/tag; one gauge value stated per round size from the governing adopted mechanical code (ch.1346), not IRC chapter 16.
evidence.method: pdftotext p163-165; takeoff.json 'ducts' (gauge only on rectangular rows); revisor.mn.gov rules 1322.1103 / 1346.0603 (search snippets; current ch.1346 text not read).

findings.proposed_fix: Label by tag or EquipmentKind display name; set round-duct gauge from ch.1346 and cite it.

findings.title: ERV sensible recovery effectiveness 0.65 is Broan's -13 F figure at 83 cfm, not at the ~204 cfm the house runs; G-005's 6,547 BTU/h ventilation load rides on it

evidence.measured: Spec sheet p.1: 'SRE of 78% at 32 F (81 CFM) and 65% at -13 F (83 CFM) and SRE of 81% at 32 F (64 CFM)'. Type source string quotes '81% at 32 F and 65% at -13 F' without the flows; sensible_recovery_effectiveness=0.65 is applied to 203.9 cfm; G-005 'ventilation air 6,547 BTU/h'. Higher airflow lowers SRE; no value at 204 cfm is published on the sheet read.
